```{r Step 1: Get Metro Area Geographical Data, include=TRUE}
# Get CBSA boundaries and calculate areas
cbsa_geo <- get_acs(
  geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
  variables = "B01001_001", # Total population as placeholder
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE
) %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, geometry) %>%
  mutate(
    cbsa_code = GEOID,
    cbsa_name = NAME,
    area_sq_miles = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) * 3.861e-7
  )

# Keep geometry-free version for joining
cbsa_reference <- cbsa_geo %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(cbsa_code, cbsa_name, area_sq_miles)

# Key ACS variables for employment
employment_vars <- c(
  "B08301_001", # Total commuters (proxy for employed)
  "B08301_010", # Work from home
  "B23025_002", # Labor force
  "B23025_005", # Unemployed
  "B25003_001"  # Total occupied housing units (for context)
)

# Key County Business Patterns variables  
cbp_vars <- c(
  "CBP2021.EMP",    # Total employment
  "CBP2021.ESTAB",  # Number of establishments
  "CBP2021.PAYANN"  # Annual payroll
)
```

```{r Step 2: Get Employment Data, include=TRUE}
# Function to get employment data by year
get_employment_data <- function(year) {
  get_acs(
    geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
    variables = employment_vars,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5"  
  ) %>%
    select(-moe) %>%  # Remove margin of error for now
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = variable,
      values_from = estimate
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      cbsa_code = GEOID,
      year = year,
      total_commuters = B08301_001,
      work_from_home = B08301_010,
      labor_force = B23025_002,
      unemployed = B23025_005,
      # Calculate employed as labor force minus unemployed
      employed = labor_force - unemployed,
      # Employment rate
      employment_rate = employed / labor_force
    )
}

# Get data for all available years (ACS 5-year available from 2009+)
employment_years <- c(2011:2019, 2021:2024)  # Adjust based on latest available
employment_data <- map_dfr(employment_years, get_employment_data)
```

```{r Step 3: Get Business Data, include=TRUE}
# Note: CBP data comes at county level, need to aggregate to CBSA
# First get county-to-CBSA crosswalk
county_cbsa_xwalk <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",

) %>%
  select(county_fips = GEOID, county_name = NAME) %>%

# Get industry employment as proxy for business activity
industry_employment_vars <- c(
  "C24050_001",  # Total employed

  "C24050_002",  # Agriculture
  "C24050_008",  # Construction
  "C24050_014",  # Manufacturing  
  "C24050_020",  # Wholesale trade
  "C24050_029",  # Retail trade
  "C24050_033",  # Transportation and warehousing
  "C24050_038",  # Information
  "C24050_044",  # Finance, insurance, real estate
  "C24050_049",  # Professional, scientific, technical services
  "C24050_055",  # Education and health services
  "C24050_060",  # Leisure and hospitality (arts, entertainment, food)
  "C24050_065",  # Other services
  "C24050_074"   # Public administration (include or exclude depending on your theory)
)


get_industry_employment_cbsa <- function(year) {

  df <- get_acs(
    geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
    variables = industry_employment_vars,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5"
  ) %>%
    select(-moe) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) %>%
    mutate(
      cbsa_code = GEOID,
      year = year,
      total_employed = C24050_001
    ) %>%

    # ----------------------------
    # 1. Rename to meaningful labels
    # ----------------------------
    transmute(
      cbsa_code,
      year,
      total_employed,

      agriculture = C24050_002,
      construction = C24050_008,
      manufacturing = C24050_014,
      wholesale_trade = C24050_020,
      retail_trade = C24050_029,
      transportation_warehousing = C24050_033,
      information = C24050_038,
      finance_real_estate = C24050_044,
      professional_services = C24050_049,
      education_health = C24050_055,
      leisure_hospitality = C24050_060,
      other_services = C24050_065,
      public_administration = C24050_074
    )
  
  # ----------------------------
  # 2. Compute shares safely
  # ----------------------------
  industry_cols <- c(
    "agriculture",
    "construction",
    "manufacturing",
    "wholesale_trade",
    "retail_trade",
    "transportation_warehousing",
    "information",
    "finance_real_estate",
    "professional_services",
    "education_health",
    "leisure_hospitality",
    "other_services",
    "public_administration"
  )

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      across(all_of(industry_cols), ~ .x / total_employed)
    ) %>%

    # ----------------------------
    # 3. HHI + diversity
    # ----------------------------
    mutate(
      industry_hhi = rowSums(across(all_of(industry_cols), ~ (.x)^2), na.rm = TRUE),
      industry_diversity = 1 - industry_hhi
    )

  return(df)
}
# Get the data
employment_years <- c(2010:2019, 2021:2024)
industry_employment_data <- map_dfr(employment_years, get_industry_employment_cbsa)

```

```{r Step 4: Calculate CBSA Density, include=TRUE}
# Get CBSA boundaries and areas
cbsa_geo <- get_acs(
  geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
  variables = "B01001_001", # Total population as placeholder
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
) %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, geometry) %>%
  mutate(
    cbsa_code = GEOID,
    cbsa_name = NAME,
    area_sq_miles = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) * 3.861e-7
  )

# Create reference table without geometry for easy joining
cbsa_reference <- cbsa_geo %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(cbsa_code, cbsa_name, area_sq_miles)
```

```{r Step 5: Finish Up Employment Density Measures, include=TRUE}
cbsa_employment_density <- industry_employment_data %>%
  left_join(cbsa_reference, by = "cbsa_code") %>%
  filter(!is.na(area_sq_miles), !is.na(total_employed)) %>%
  mutate(
    total_employment_density = total_employed / area_sq_miles,
    log_employment_density = log(total_employment_density),
    employment_density_z = scale(log_employment_density)[,1]
  )
```

```{r Step 6: Construct Housing Density Measure, include=TRUE}
housing_vars <- c(
  housing_units = "B25001_001"
)

get_housing_cbsa <- function(year) {

  get_acs(
    geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
    variables = housing_vars,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5"
  ) %>%
    select(-moe) %>%
    mutate(
      cbsa_code = GEOID,
      year = year,
      housing_units = estimate
    ) %>%
    select(cbsa_code, year, housing_units)

}

years <- c(2010:2019, 2021:2024)

housing_data <- map_dfr(years, get_housing_cbsa)

housing_data <- housing_data %>%
  left_join(cbsa_reference, by = "cbsa_code")

housing_data <- housing_data %>%
  mutate(
    housing_density = housing_units / area_sq_miles,
    log_housing_density = log(housing_density + 1)
  )

housing_data <- housing_data %>%
  mutate(
    z_housing_density = as.numeric(scale(log_housing_density))
  )

housing_data <- housing_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(housing_density))
```


```{r Step 7: Final Merges, include=TRUE}
cbsa_employment_density <- cbsa_employment_density %>%
  left_join(
    housing_data %>% select(cbsa_code, housing_units, year, housing_density, log_housing_density, z_housing_density),
    by = c("cbsa_code", "year")
  )

final_agglo_data <- analysis_data %>%
  left_join(
    cbsa_employment_density,
    by = c("GEOID" = "cbsa_code", "year" = "year")
  )


write_csv(final_agglo_data, here("01_tidydata", "metrotabledata.csv"))
```
